text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The European Union special envoy's office in the divided Bosnian city of Mostar begins final registration of refugees wishing to return to their homes.
- Only $139.7 million of the World Bank's $470 million credit for Bosnia in 1996 had been received as of September 18, the newspaper reports.

- An international car show begins in Sarajevo's Skenderija exhibition hall on Tuesday. About 70 auto manufacturers including Volkswagen, Renault, Nissan, Skoda and Rover are expected to display products at the five-day fair. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
